page_title: SAS 0-2 LAZ | Sassuolo v Lazio 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' Lazio slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90+1' Shots on target – 2:6.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
88' The referee signals a substitution. Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Andrea Pinamonti.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
82' Matias Vecino (Lazio) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.

81' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
80' Taty Castellanos comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ciro Immobile (Lazio).
79' Here is a change. Luis Alberto is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Daichi Kamada (Lazio).
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) was quite harsh and Marco Di Bello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.
75' Luis Alberto (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Marco Di Bello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

74' The fans were almost celebrating as Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Andrea Consigli made an astonishing save!
72' Matias Vecino (Lazio) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
70' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
67' It is time for a substitution. Matias Vecino (Lazio) is on for Matteo Guendouzi.
65' Referee Marco Di Bello waves Ivan Provedel (Lazio) back on as his red card is expunged after a VAR review!
64' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Ivan Provedel (Lazio)! Let's see what he decides.
63' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) gets a yellow card, off the field.
62' Ivan Provedel (Lazio) is sent off with a straight red card. He can't believe his eyes, but the referee's call is final.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samu Castillejo leaves the pitch and Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) comes on.
59' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
57' OFF THE POST! Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
55' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
53' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Pedro and he is replaced by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio).
53' The substitution has been made. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) has replaced Nicolo Rovella.

52' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Sassuolo are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
51' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' The game is interrupted. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
47' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Alessio Dionisi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Uros Racic (Sassuolo). He is replaced by Kristian Thorstvedt.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) comes off for Matias Vina.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Alessio Dionisi gives a chance to Martin Erlic and Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) is off.
46' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Pedro (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
42' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
40' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' 0:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
35' 0 - 2 Goal! Luis Alberto (Lazio) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:2.
33' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
31' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
28' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Taty Castellanos sets up Felipe Anderson (Lazio) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
26' It looks like Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) saw red with that tackle. Marco Di Bello won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
24' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
21' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
19' Lazio fail to score from a corner as Andrea Consigli (Sassuolo) leaps to collect the ball.

18' Andrea Consigli pulls off a great save to deny Felipe Anderson (Lazio) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Lazio earn a corner.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
15' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the left post.
12' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
8' Close! Luis Alberto (Lazio) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
6' Luis Alberto (Lazio) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
3' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Lazio will kick the game off.
Marco Di Bello got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
